historical_run_scope: The original 26/10 assertion run used 5.1.71 runtime, not the complete 5.1.72 package. A source comparison confirms services/api/src, cloud/src, services/api/prisma and cloud/prisma are unchanged in 5.1.72. Exact 5.1.72 package runtime follow-up results are recorded in exact_candidate_runtime_rerun below.

exact_candidate_runtime_rerun.database_environment: Same isolated PostgreSQL 16.15 databases and synthetic-only fixtures; no production/customer data. Current 5.1.72 API and Cloud packages were started from the candidate build.
exact_candidate_runtime_rerun.api_authorization_assertions: PASS 5/5; two DB-bound tenant-admin identities, same-tenant session creation, tenant-isolated list/detail/update, persisted status/metadata, denied tenant reassignment, orphan deletion and role elevation.
exact_candidate_runtime_rerun.cloud_authorization_assertions: PASS 10/10; tenant company/session scope, foreign ID denial, cross-tenant session read/update denial, persisted allowed update and forbidden tenant/role changes. List checks required inclusion of own synthetic session and exclusion of the other tenant's session because the reused disposable DB already contained earlier synthetic rows.
exact_candidate_runtime_rerun.api_two_instance_persistence: PASS; session created on API instance 1, read/updated on instance 2, and read back on instance 1.
exact_candidate_runtime_rerun.api_restart_persistence: PASS; session status/metadata read back after restarting API 5.1.72.
exact_candidate_runtime_rerun.cloud_restart_persistence: PASS; session status/metadata read back after restarting Cloud 5.1.72.
exact_candidate_runtime_rerun.cleanup: API, Cloud and PostgreSQL stopped; listeners on ports 55438 and 3041-3043 absent.

api.5_1_72_rerun: PASS; 9 migrations found, no pending migrations

cloud.5_1_72_rerun: PASS; 7 migrations found, no pending migrations

checks: Authenticated actor role, company and team are resolved from persisted database identity.
Superadmin creates synthetic companies, brands and teams; tenant administrators read only their own company and cannot create or delete companies or elevate roles.
Tenant administrators list and access own sessions; foreign tenant session detail and update are denied with HTTP 403.
Allowed own-tenant status and metadata updates persist and read back; legacy summary and tenant reassignment writes are denied.
Company reassignment, role elevation and orphan-session deletion are denied to tenant administrators.
api.restart_persistence: PASS; database-backed login and session status/metadata readback survived API restart.
api.multi_instance: PASS; a session created through API instance 1 was read and updated through instance 2 using the same database, then read back through instance 1.

checks: Cloud derives the tenant from the persisted actor; own-company list/detail succeeds and foreign direct detail returns HTTP 403.
Cross-tenant session list/read/update is denied while each tenant can list and update its own session.
Own status/metadata changes persist; company reassignment, company creation and role elevation are denied.
cloud.restart_persistence: PASS; database-backed actor authentication and session status/metadata readback survived Cloud restart.

database_constraints.api: PASS; same-tenant flow permission/version insert accepted; cross-company composite foreign key rejected; duplicate flow version rejected.
database_constraints.cloud: PASS; same-tenant flow permission/version insert accepted; cross-company composite foreign key rejected; duplicate flow version rejected.

cleanup: API instances, Cloud and PostgreSQL stopped; loopback listeners on ports 55438 and 3041-3043 were verified absent. A stopped isolated PostgreSQL binary/data bundle remains in the task-specific temporary directory for reproducibility.
limitations: The original 5.1.71 run is retained as historical evidence. The exact 5.1.72 rerun additionally confirms migrations are current, focused tenant/session authorization, restart persistence in API and Cloud, and API two-instance persistence. This still does not complete the exhaustive resource × role × operation × surface matrix.
The synthetic initial superadmin fixture was provisioned directly in the empty disposable database; tenant actions and subsequent authentication were exercised through the API.
Native Electron/device/audio, broad accessibility/localization, deployed SEO/AEO, live Qdrant concurrency and client-specific call/CRM acceptance remain open.
Three Session API lifecycle/ownership inventory rows still require a retention/audit decision.
No production database, customer identity/data, customer endpoint or deployment was used.
